about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport P300e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport P300e is the plug-in hybrid variant of the L550-generation Discovery Sport, introduced in 2020 as Land Rover's first PHEV offering in the compact SUV segment. It combines the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine — with an electric motor, delivering a combined output of around 300PS. The petrol side of the drivetrain is shared with the non-hybrid P200 and P250 Ingenium petrol variants, though the P300e's specific application includes hybrid-specific systems that require specialist attention during any engine work.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200P + electric motor engines for every Discovery Sport P300e on the road.
